observations.why: The proportional cost-benefit framing (15x speed) enacts market-pricing: the decision is justified by quantified return, not hierarchy or shared identity.
A selection framed as a tool-for-purpose match — proportionality between capability and need, not rank or reciprocity.
Quantified performance gain frames the choice in cost-benefit proportionality — the hallmark of market-pricing.
A scheduled commitment tied to a proportional plan — the timeline is a consequence-for-choice frame, not a command or reciprocal exchange.
